note: Wizard World's overlay on the legacy Deathtrap zones (legacy_zones.json): adapted texts, two-player rules and provenance. `ported` lists the zones the host plays; the rest are drawn by the developer tools only until their milestone. Encoding slips in the legacy export (the long dash) are corrected here.

dd_entrance/dd_table.text: A stone table. Six boxes; five already taken. The contestants ahead of you helped themselves.

dd_entrance/aid_box.text: A box bearing the settlement's seal, the one the Rollkeeper stamped on the roll. Inside: two gold pieces, and a note in a sharp hand. SUKUMVIT: 'The Trial wants useful things, not just strong arms. Carry what matters.'
dd_entrance/aid_box.two_player: one box per apprentice: the second finds theirs beside it

dd_fork/dd_prints_west.text: Wet footprints, several sets, head west along the road.

dd_fork/dd_east_draught.text: A cold draught from the east, and a single small footprint pressed into the wet. Someone slight went this way and did not come back for their box.

dd_fork/dd_empty_box.text: An open box, its seal broken. Someone got here first, and went west.

dd_lower/troll_lower1.intro:
Two Cave Trolls blunder in, clubs up, and Throm is suddenly beside you, smelling of rope and anger.

"Mine's the big one," he says, and takes it.

Yours weaves Flame and Frost.
dd_lower/troll_lower1.two_player: with two apprentices present each duels a troll and Throm shouts advice; with one, Throm takes the second troll (his outcome is authored: he wins, wounded)

dd_fork/fly_east.intro: Something huge buzzes in the eastern dark. It smells of Frost.

lines: The Trialmaster at your service. Locked doors are my speciality.

trial_ready: The cobra is ready. He waits in the arena. Finish it.
trial_done: The way is open. Go, and don't thank me.

dd_trialmaster/throm_arena.name: Throm, delirious
dd_trialmaster/throm_arena.intro:
They drag Throm into the arena. His eyes don't know you. The Dwarf's crossbow says only one of you leaves.

Three slots of Flame, Stone and Frost; he weaves like a man asleep.

dd_trialmaster/dd_tunnel_tease.text: A concealed tunnel breathes cold air from the south-west corner. The Dwarf's crossbow does not waver. Not yet.

text_run_flag.trial_done: The concealed tunnel breathes cold air from the south-west corner. The crossbow is lowered. West, then.

dd_idol/guard_idol1.intro:
The stuffed birds open their eyes. All of them.

Two colours of whatever shines: read them like a Ward and break them.

dd_idol/emerald_eye.text:
The emerald eye comes away in your hand. It is heavier than a sin.

EMERALD.

dd_grotto/elf_bread.text: Her bread, packed with healing herbs. You eat. The shaking stops; the hurt goes.

dd_grotto/elf_charm.text: Her vine-charm. It curls around your wrist like it was always yours. Green things will know you carry it.

dd_vaults/sapphire_box.text:
A box, an iron key, and a sapphire the size of a robin's egg.

SAPPHIRE, and the key fits the northern lock.

dd_vault_inner/true_diamond.text:
A diamond in a hall of echoes: real, cold, and yours.

DIAMOND.

dd_mirror/light_shard.text:
A shard of mirror-light. It wants to be a spell.

You have learned LIGHT.

dd_blood/blood_clue.text:
Bitter herbs, chewed and spat out. Something with a tongue hates Vine the way fire hates water.

(The Bloodbeast's Ward will not hold Vine.)

grant_on_win.text:
The beast dissolves into its own shadow, and the shadow stays.

You have learned SHADOW.

dd_troglodytes/dd_tube.text: A hollow tube, wax-sealed at both ends. For breathing underwater, if it comes to that.

dd_manticore/red_settle.why: the Red Wizard is not canon (docs/TRIAL_CANON_STATUS.md); Wizard World's rival is the stranger of the opening

dd_manticore/manticore_gate1.intro:
The last gate has teeth, wings, and patience.

Four slots. It has been waiting longer than you.

dd_igbut/victory_door.text: A door of black stone with three empty sockets, gem-sized, in a row.

text_run_flag.dungeon_complete: The black door stands open on daylight.
